title: 布尔索引、where 与 select 的分支选择
expected_output:
a = [ 1 -2  3 -4  5]
掩码 a>0 = [ True False  True False  True] | dtype = bool
a[a > 0] = [1 3 5]
--- where 的两种用法 ---
三参 where(a>0, a, 0) = [1 0 3 0 5]
单参 where(a>0)       = [0 2 4] （返回下标）
--- select 多分支 ---
np.select(...) = [ 0 -1  0 -1  1]
--- 掩码统计 ---
正数个数 = 3 | 负数均值 = -3.0
--- 掩码写回 ---
把负数清零后 b = [1 0 3 0 5]
code:
import numpy as np
a = np.array([1, -2, 3, -4, 5])
print("a =", a)
m = a > 0
print("掩码 a>0 =", m, "| dtype =", m.dtype)
print("a[a > 0] =", a[a > 0])
print("--- where 的两种用法 ---")
print("三参 where(a>0, a, 0) =", np.where(a > 0, a, 0))
print("单参 where(a>0)       =", np.where(a > 0)[0], "（返回下标）")
print("--- select 多分支 ---")
cond = [a < 0, (a >= 0) & (a < 4), a >= 4]
print("np.select(...) =", np.select(cond, [-1, 0, 1], default=99))
print("--- 掩码统计 ---")
print("正数个数 =", int((a > 0).sum()), "| 负数均值 =", float(a[a < 0].mean()))
print("--- 掩码写回 ---")
b = a.copy()
b[b < 0] = 0
print("把负数清零后 b =", b)
